body: The section `What nothing measures reads as nothing wide` ends with what was said instead for the fold and the chips. `cc59d79` carried the other half -- the forty-one `apply` fields across nine `src/ui/*.cc` that lost their `.autoSize` -- and this adds it to the same section: a text now keeps the width and height `measure()` already computed, which is how `skiff-widgets` itself carries texts, and the rule for what is written after -- a leaf that asks for `autoSize` measures its words correctly and still stands at no bounds, which on a page reads right and presses nowhere. One paragraph, no code.
title: the rule for texts written after this, said where the fault was written down
